newsitem.title: USA: Municipal bond sales total $474 mln for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Municipal bond sales total $474 mln for Tuesday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Tuesday, August 19, were expected to total $474 billion in 31 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.

Negotiated offerings totalled $235 million in 12 sales, with a $46 million Texas Housing Agency offering through John Nuveen & Co., Inc. topping the list. To see the full negotiated sales calendar, double click on NEGO1.

On the competitive side, 19 sales totaling $239 million were scheduled. A $62 million Fort Bend Independent School District, Texas, offering topping the list. To see the full competitive sales calendar, double click on COMP1.
An additional five sales totaling $80 million were on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Tuesday depending on market conditions.
For the full note calendar, double click on NOTE1.
